name: console-07-new-client
prompt: Turn this into a different screen of the same console, edge to edge with no browser window. Keep exactly: the left sidebar (with "Clients" selected) and the visual system. Replace the whole main area, top to bottom: no Munchly header, no tabs, no agent list and no side panel remain. Main area, a step-by-step setup flow: 1) A large title "New client" and the grey line "Step 3 of 7 · Supply chain". 2) A narrow vertical step list on the left of the main area: "Company" and "Workspace" with green ticks, "Supply chain" highlighted as current, then "Exits", "Agents", "People", "Review" in grey. 3) In the middle, three questions, each as a row of selectable white option cards with a thin hairline edge, the chosen card with a green border and a green tick: "Route to market": "Through distributors" (chosen), "Direct to modern trade", "Own warehouses and D2C"; "Who owns short-dated stock": "The distributor" (chosen), "The manufacturer"; "Expiry policy": "Full credit at expiry" (chosen), "Price support only", "No returns". 4) On the right, a white summary card "What this profile sets up" with four short lines, each with a small green icon: "Agents list, offer and invoice in the distributor's name, after his one-time permission", "Price support is offered before stock expires", "Exits: marketplace, kiranas, staff sale, food bank", "D2C stays off: it is only for your own stock". Under it a grey line "Every plan still waits for one person's approval." 5) At the bottom right, a white button "Back" and a dark green button "Continue". Crisp flat interface; all text legible.
postprocess: WebP; the PNG original stays local in .impeccable/mocks/
use: SC-25 design board: New client setup, step 3 of 7: questions for route to market, who owns short-dated stock and expiry policy as option cards, with a summary card listing what the profile sets up.
